hero.title: Postgraduate Aerospace Engineering in Switzerland in Switzerland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Students interested in aerodynamics, aircraft structures, propulsion, flight mechanics, space systems, robotics and advanced materials can pursue a Master’s in Aerospace Engineering in Switzerland. Switzerland is home to a strong technical research environment, and you can study aerospace-related topics in mechanical engineering, robotics, control systems and computational engineering programs. **A Master’s in Aerospace Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** offers an opportunity to explore these subjects through advanced technical education and research.

highlights.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in Engineering + English/German proficiency

overview:
**Master in Aerospace Engineering in Switzerland**, to explore advanced engineering subjects and opportunities for aerospace research.

Indian students need to be aware that not all Swiss universities will offer a program with the specific name "Aerospace Engineering". Similar engineering routes are available at ETH Zurich and EPFL, but applicants should verify that the current curriculum matches their aerospace interests. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** can help students understand the available study routes and prepare for their applications.
